stages.name: lung_prepare_input
stages.command: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; from lung_annotation_pipeline.prepare_input import prepare_lung_input; summary = prepare_lung_input(Path('data/lung_run/input/lung_cluster_markers.csv'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/processed/lung_cluster_markers_pipeline.csv'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/panel/panel_gene_list.csv'), min_log2fc=0.5, max_adjusted_p_value=0.05, top_k=50); print(summary)"

stages.name: lung_agent1_sources
stages.command: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; from lung_annotation_pipeline.run_agent1 import run_agent1; output = run_agent1(Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/panel/panel_gene_list.csv'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/agent1_output'), species='Human', tissue='Lung', platform='Xenium'); print(output)"

stages.name: lung_agent2_marker_interpretation
stages.command: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; from lung_annotation_pipeline.run_agent2 import run_agent2; output = run_agent2(Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/processed/lung_cluster_markers_pipeline.csv'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/panel/panel_gene_list.csv'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean/agent1_output/panel_agent1_knowledge_evidence.json'), Path('data/pipeline_runs/lung_validated_clean'), top_k=50); print(output)"
